title: OceanWP WordPress Theme before 4.2.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the…
description: OceanWP WordPress Theme versions before 4.2.9 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the oceanwp_edd_terms_list() function. This flaw allows authenticated users with Easy Digital Downloads (EDD) download category creation permissions to inject malicious JavaScript by crafting a specially formed category name. The injected script executes in the browsers of visitors who interact with the affected category link on the public EDD archive page, potentially compromising administrator sessions if they view the page while authenticated.
